verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents bring-your-own-key use: the hosted tier says "Just bring an LLM API Key", and users report using both local and API-based models, including closed models. The pack has no evidence of any token-usage or cost view, per model or per conversation, which is half of the story. Missing for 10: token usage tracking, cost reporting per model or per conversation, subscription-based (non-API-key) backend support, independent corroboration of BYOK configuration depth.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, I bring my own API keys or subscriptions and can see token usage and cost per model or per conversation
